messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I found a customer prompt in the eval-runner debug logs after a quant bring-up test on staging. Not in S3, it was in the CI job logs.
Tom: Oh no. Which CI job/test?
Maya: run 2026-03-15_09:12 on eval-runner-quant. Log snippet (redacted here for thread):
```/tmp/eval-runner/logs/20260315/worker-3.log: INFO: request.payload: {"prompt":"Order number 12345 belongs to Acme Corp - contact joe@acme.example"}```
Reza: Is that from a synthetic seed or an actual customer sample? We need to know scope.
Maya: It was a customer-sourced prompt. The harness pulls real sample prompts from eval-sample-sync for regression checks. Looks like the redaction step only ran for hosted-path adapters, not the local/gptq adapter.
Tom: That sounds like a CI wiring bug — the redaction middleware isn’t registered for the local-runner adapter. I can reproduce with the same job config.
Jen: Let's label this blocker. Do we stop the quant bring-up on staging until this is fixed?
Maya: Filed an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/issues/2312 (details + sample logs). Suggest immediate mitigation before we continue tests.
eval-bot: deploy-bot noticed: staging-job-9087 uploaded artifacts to gs://redwood-eval-logs/staging/9087/ (unredacted) — retention 30d.
Reza: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revoke GCS write from CI job, 2) purge leaked artifacts, 3) rotate the CI service account keys, 4) add a CI gate that fails if PII patterns (emails, account numbers) are found in logs.
Tom: I'm pushing a small patch to ensure redaction decorator wraps the local adapter path. Will open PR now (quickfix).
Jen: @ops-sre can you confirm purge + credential rotation? Also we should avoid a full rollback if the model bring-up itself is fine; just stop noisy tests.
ops-sre: Purge started — removed 3 artifacts from the staging bucket and queued a creds rotation for the CI service account. Adding incident annotation to the runbook.
Maya: Post-fix follow-ups: add unit tests asserting redaction for quant/local adapters, add a static lint in eval-ci to detect raw `prompt` fields in logs, and update the runbook to include CI log access checks.
Tom: PR #2313 opened with the middleware registration fix and a test. Will add the lint in a follow-up.
Jen: Thanks everyone. Moving this to the incident board and scheduling a short postmortem to capture why the adapter registration was missed. :white_check_mark:
Maya: I'll pair with Tom on the tests and draft the postmortem notes.
